# Sweep-4 ingest — corpus v0.2.1 addendum (Workstream J-ADDENDUM)

*Generated by `ml/corpus/report_v0_2_1.py` from the build sidecars (git-ignored under `data/`). Token unit **kreyol-bpe**. This is an INCREMENTAL build on top of the frozen corpus v0.2 (see [corpus_v0_2.md](corpus_v0_2.md)): the four verified TRAIN-OK sweep-4 sources (docs/data.md §1 sweep-4 rows) are deduped STRICTLY — exact + MinHash — against the FULL v0.2 corpus and appended. They add register COVERAGE (translated newswire, historical literary), not scale.*

## Headline

- **219.6M** unique kreyol-bpe tokens (316,185 docs) — corpus v0.2 219.2M + **438k net-new** from sweep-4 (400 docs).
- Registers added: **news_translated, health_translated, historical_literary** (all held at mix weight 1× — register coverage, not authored-voice amplification; pre-reform orthography stays identifiable + down-weightable).
- **3 of 4 sources ingested**; Lessons in Haitian Creole (1921) **abandoned on OCR-quality grounds** (see below). One Cric? Crac! fable held out entirely as a heritage exhibit.

| *cross-new dedup removed* | | | | | | −0 | | |

**Dedup discipline (spec):** CMU newswire overlaps WMT11-era releases and possibly the crawl, so every sweep-4 doc is checked EXACT (content hash) **and** MinHash (Jaccard 0.8) against the full v0.2 corpus (v0.1 base + all J survivors). The check is inverted for memory — a tiny LSH over the few hundred sweep-4 candidates, with the 315k-doc v0.2 shard streamed through it once. Note: CMU sentences are chunked ~40/doc, so cross-corpus overlap is caught at chunk granularity; sentence-level exact overlap below the document Jaccard threshold is not separately chased (same documented limit as `corpus/dedup.py`).

**Probe-proverb guard (standing rule):** load-bearing for Cric? Crac! (these are fables — famous proverbs recur). Every page/passage is screened against the 15 held-out probe proverbs before it can enter training; pages excluded: Cric 0, Anthologie 0.

## OCR / extraction quality verdicts

- **CMU Haitian Corpus — usable (no OCR).** Direct text download under the CMU permissive license. Newswire 13268 + medical 1246 translated sentences → 364 chunked docs. The `glossary-all-fix.{ht,en}` **dictionary → 32231 EN↔HT lexicon pairs** (`data/interim/v0_2_1_ingest/cmu_lexicon.json`, git-ignored) — a lexicon resource, deliberately **NOT** mixed into the LM training text (may feed SFT/eval later).
- **Cric? Crac! (1901) — usable, rough OCR.** Sourced from dLOC's own page-level OCR (`UF00076576`, patron API `pagetext`, 241 pages) — the Creighton 1901 item has no scan bitstreams. The book prints facing French (La Fontaine) + Kreyòl; page-level language separation keeps the HT-dominant pages → 28 fable-run docs. 1901 pre-reform orthography preserved EXACTLY (artifacts: `9a`=ça/sa, `6`=é, `td`=te, `gnou`=yon). One complete fable held out for the exhibit.
- **Anthologie d'un siècle de poésie haïtienne (1925) — usable, clean.** Manioc CC0 PDF has a clean embedded TEXT LAYER (PyMuPDF; no OCR). Predominantly French; 8 Kreyòl-dense pages of 408 → 8 docs. langid fails on the historical orthography, so Kreyòl passages were isolated by a marker pass then reviewed.
- **Lessons in Haitian Creole (1921) — ABANDONED.** English pedagogical manual; Kreyòl appears only as isolated vocabulary entries and verb-conjugation paradigm cells (1:1 with English prompts), heavily OCR-corrupted. No extractable Kreyòl prose (densest contiguous block ~a 'vini' conjugation drill). Not ingested to avoid injecting English + OCR noise. (measured: 16 Kreyòl-ish lines / 319 clean chars in the IA `_djvu.txt`). TRAIN-OK by rights (PD); recorded, not ingested.

## Heritage exhibit — oldest text connected to the model

One complete Cric? Crac! (1901) fable — **"Le Loup, la Chèvre et le Chevreau"** (the wolf-at-the-door / password fable), dLOC pageorders 38–41 (~398 kreyol-bpe tokens) — is held out of training **entirely** and saved as [heritage_cric_crac_fable.md](heritage_cric_crac_fable.md). It is not in the v0.2.1 shard (leak-check in build_stats: 0). "The oldest text connected to the model" is only an exhibit fact if the model never trained on it.

## Reproduce

```bash
cd ml && uv sync
uv run python -m corpus.sweep4 all          # download + extract (CMU/Cric/Anthologie; Lessons measured)
uv run python -m corpus.build_v0_2_1         # dedup vs full v0.2 (streamed) + append -> v0.2.1
uv run python -m corpus.report_v0_2_1        # this report + the heritage asset
```

Nothing under `ml/data/` is committed. No new committable data artifact here (the CMU lexicon is git-ignored under `data/`); the only committed outputs are this report, the heritage fable exhibit, and the registry/doc updates.
